directive:
TARGET ONLY prop:separated-reduction.

Reframe this proposition so it is independent of oeq:full-profile-frontier. Remove every assertion involving Phi_{n,m}, C^star_{n,m}, the claim that an attaining full-profile family has a bounded separated-profile oracle ratio, and the first-order midpoint equivalence between C^star_{n,m} and C^{sign}_{n,m}. Remove oeq:full-profile-frontier from this proposition’s depends_on list. Do not alter, weaken, solve, or delete oeq:full-profile-frontier; all claims about Phi_{n,m}, q_{n,m}, and the globally attaining C^star_{n,m} must remain there.

Retain and prove the strongest separated-profile statement available under the existing assumptions:

(1) For fixed m >= 1 and 0 < xi <= a_m, as n -> infinity, sup-uniformly over h in H_m(xi), ell_{n,m}(h) asymp_{m,xi,delta_0} n^{-1/2}.

(2) Retain the displayed uniform exponential sign-recovery bound, the uniform asymptotic linear expansion of the two signed-cell endpoint centers, variance consistency, asymptotic independence across v=0,1, and the jointly calibrated limiting-coverage conclusion for C^{sign}_{n,m}. Describe C^{sign}_{n,m} only as an asymptotically valid regular benchmark; do not claim that it belongs to the finite-sample globally honest class.

For the upper bound in (1), add the following independent finite-sample honest coordinate-rectangle construction. Define W_{i,v,j}=8m 1{V_i=v,J_i=j,S_i=0,T_i=v}R_i, bar W_{v,j}=n^{-1} sum_i W_{i,v,j}, tilde h_{v,j}=Pi_{[-a_m,a_m]}(bar W_{v,j}), and r_{n,m}=m sqrt{128 log(4m/delta_0)/n}. Let I_{v,j}=[max{-a_m,tilde h_{v,j}-r_{n,m}}, min{a_m,tilde h_{v,j}+r_{n,m}}]. For each v, let D_v be the exact image of the product rectangle prod_j I_{v,j} under g_v -> m^{-1} sum_j |g_{v,j}|; equivalently its lower and upper endpoints are the sums of the coordinatewise minimum and maximum absolute values. Output the endpoint images C_L=-b+kD_0 and C_U=b-kD_1.

Since E_h W_{i,v,j}=h_{v,j} and W_{i,v,j} lies in an interval of length at most 16m, Hoeffding plus a union bound over 2m coordinates gives simultaneous containment of h in the rectangle with probability at least 1-delta_0 for every h in H_m. Thus this auxiliary rule is a finite-sample member of I_{n,m}. Each D_v has length at most 2r_{n,m}, so its summed endpoint risk is at most 4k r_{n,m}=O_{m,delta_0}(n^{-1/2}). Combine this with thm:oracle-positivity, whose lower bound becomes c k n^{-1/2} for fixed m and all sufficiently large n, to prove (1), uniformly even over H_m.

It is permissible to record the resulting corollary that this auxiliary coordinate-rectangle rule has sup_{h in H_m(xi)} R_{n,m}(C,h)/ell_{n,m}(h)=O_{m,xi,delta_0}(1). State clearly that this fixed-m corollary neither identifies the sharp full-profile adaptation order q_{n,m} uniformly in m nor supplies the C^star_{n,m} demanded by oeq:full-profile-frontier.

Update the proposition’s justification, gap, obligation, and partial-result text consistently: the proposition is now a proved regular fixed-dimensional reduction; the unresolved full-profile-family and midpoint-equivalence claims belong exclusively to oeq:full-profile-frontier.

MAXIMALITY REVISION — sharpen the globally honest rectangle and synchronize causal scope.

Scope: def:coordinate-rectangle-interval and its dedicated symbols; prop:separated-reduction only where it uses that definition; add one proved global upper-envelope theorem/corollary; oeq:full-profile-frontier obligation/partial-result prose only; causal-specialization justification/consumer and global TLDR/project/sampling/technical-limitation/honest-scope prose. Do not change the mathematical assumptions, the proved lower bounds, or the displayed high-information conjectural slice.

1. Replace the inverse-cell-probability Hoeffding rectangle by the sharper capped-cell rectangle already supported by thm:nuisance-learnability. Remove the globally defined W_{i,v,j}, bar W_{v,j}, and tilde h_{v,j} symbols if they have no remaining nonlocal use. Retain hat h_{v,j} from def:capped-estimator and define rcap_{n,m}=min{2a_m,sqrt(32m log(6m/delta_0)/n)}, Icap_{v,j}=[max{-a_m,hat h_{v,j}-rcap},min{a_m,hat h_{v,j}+rcap}]. Let Dcap_v be the exact image of product_j Icap_{v,j} under g_v -> m^{-1}sum_j|g_{v,j}|, and let Ccaprect_{n,m}=(-b+kDcap_0,b-kDcap_1).

2. Prove finite-sample honesty directly from the tail calculation already established in thm:nuisance-learnability: if the square-root term is below 2a_m, equation (14) with eta=delta_0 gives simultaneous coordinate coverage; otherwise radius 2a_m covers the entire coordinate range deterministically. Projection of hat h onto the cube preserves coverage. As before, length(Dcap_v)<=2rcap, and range restriction also gives total length at most 2ka_m. Therefore state sup_h R(Ccaprect,h)<=min{2ka_m,4k rcap}<=C_0 k min{a_m,sqrt(m log(6m/delta_0)/n)}. Update prop:separated-reduction to use this sharper witness. Its fixed-m conclusions and signed-cell asymptotics remain unchanged.

3. Add a proved global upper-envelope theorem or corollary. Combining the preceding risk bound and the full-range rule with thm:oracle-positivity must give, for all n,m, A_{n,m} <= C_0 min{a_m,sqrt(m log(6m/delta_0)/n)}/min{a_m,n^{-1/2}} <= C_0 min{max{1,a_m sqrt(n)},sqrt(m log(6m/delta_0))}. Label this explicitly as an upper bound, not the sharp adaptation order. Note that its crossover occurs at na_m^2/m asymp log m.

4. Preserve oeq:full-profile-frontier as the unique construct-and-determine OEQ. Add the new global upper envelope to its partial_result and require the OEQ to determine whether the sqrt(m log m) ceiling is sharp, whether the logarithm is removable, and how the optimal family interpolates across the elbow. Do not assert the proposed mixed-profile display. Keep the existing requirement to prove it or replace it with a counterexample and the correct expression, and keep the Bernstein-degree task explicitly open.

5. Synchronize all prose. Replace references to the inverse-cell-probability rectangle by the capped-cell rectangle and state its sqrt(m log m/n) rate. Update TLDR, project_justification.fill/gap, sampling_model.nuisance_estimation, technical_internal_limitation, honest_scope, and the affected statement notes. Mention the new global adaptation upper envelope while saying that no matching higher-information lower bound or globally optimal family is known.

6. Synchronize causal scope explicitly. Describe M_{m,h} as a faithful finite paired-cell specialized subclass/fiber of the Lanners–Rudin–Volfovsky–Parikh model: treatment and study propensities are fixed at 1/2, covariates and outcome regressions are specialized, and rho=gamma=1/5. State that the paper’s positivity, internal-validity, relative-mean sensitivity, and compatibility hypotheses are verified. Add that raw expected-length lower bounds obstruct any supermodel-honest procedure on this embedded experiment, but the submodel oracle upper bounds and adaptation-factor rates do not automatically transfer to the unrestricted published class. Replace any suggestion that the actual Project STAR sampling law is analyzed by the narrower claim that the construction reproduces the same sensitivity-bound algebra in a controlled subexperiment.
